cases.sentence: Когда Иераваам стоял у ___, чтобы вожечь кадильные благовония
cases.translation: When Jeroboam stood at the altar to burn incense
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/by) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: He cried out to the altar according to Yahweh's word
cases.explain: Direct address in Russian uses the dative case for the object being addressed.

cases.sentence: Родится дому Давида ___ по имени Иосия.
cases.translation: A son will be born to the house of David, named Josiah
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb родится (will be born), so it takes nominative.

cases.sentence: Тогда царь протянул руку от ___ и сказал.
cases.translation: Then the king extended his hand from the altar and said
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He found him sitting under an oak tree
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with location governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Его тело лежало брошенным на дороге, а возле него стояли осел и ___.
cases.translation: His body lay thrown on the path, and beside it stood a donkey and a lion
cases.explain: The lion is part of a compound subject with the donkey, so both take nominative.

cases.sentence: Он положил тело в свою гробницу и оплакивал его, восклицая, «О мой ___!»
cases.translation: He placed the body in his grave and wept over him, saying, 'Oh my brother!'
cases.explain: In vocative address (direct address to someone), Russian uses nominative for the noun of address.

cases.sentence: После этого Иеравоам не переменил своего злого пути и снова назначил священников из ___ для святилищ.
cases.translation: After this Jeroboam did not depart from his evil way and appointed priests from the people for the high places
cases.explain: The preposition из (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Когда Иераваам стоял у жертвенника, чтобы вожечь кадильные благовония, из земель Иудеи в Вифиль, по слову Господа, пришел Божий человек.
reading.question: What was Jeroboam doing when the man of God arrived from Judah?
options: Standing at the altar burning incense
reading.correct: Standing at the altar burning incense
reading.explain: The text says 'Иераваам стоял у жертвенника, чтобы вожечь кадильные благовония'.

reading.ru: Он дал знамение в тот же день, говоря: вот знамение того, что это возвестил Господь. Этот жертвенник расколется, а пепел на нем будет рассыпан.
reading.question: What sign did the man of God give to prove his message was from the Lord?
options: The altar would split apart and its ashes would scatter
reading.correct: The altar would split apart and its ashes would scatter
reading.explain: The text describes the sign as the altar being split and its ashes poured out.

reading.ru: Рука, которую он протянул к тому человеку, иссохла, и он не мог повернуть ее к себе.
reading.question: What happened to the king's hand after he tried to seize the man of God?
options: His hand withered and he could not pull it back
reading.correct: His hand withered and he could not pull it back
reading.explain: The text says 'рука иссохла' - his hand dried up/withered.

reading.ru: Божий человек ответил царю, 'Даже если бы ты давал мне половину твоего добра, я не пошел бы с тобой и не стал бы ни есть здесь хлеба, ни пить воды.'
reading.question: Why did the man of God refuse the king's invitation to come to his house?
options: He had been commanded by God not to eat or drink there
He was afraid of being poisoned
He was in a hurry to leave
reading.correct: He had been commanded by God not to eat or drink there
reading.explain: The man of God explains he was commanded by the Lord not to eat or drink there.

reading.ru: А в Вифиле жил один старый пророк, сыновья которого пришли и рассказали ему обо всем, что совершил там в тот день Божий человек.
reading.question: How did the old prophet in Bethel learn about the man of God?
options: His sons came and told him about everything the man of God did
He heard it from the king
reading.correct: His sons came and told him about everything the man of God did
reading.explain: The text says 'сыновья которого пришли и рассказали ему'.

reading.ru: Он сказал сыновьям, 'Оседлайте мне осла'. Когда они оседлали ему осла, он сел на него и поехал за Божьим человеком.
reading.question: What did the old prophet do after learning where the man of God had gone?
options: He had his sons saddle a donkey and rode after the man of God
He sent his sons to find the man of God
He waited for the man of God to return
He went to the king to report
reading.correct: He had his sons saddle a donkey and rode after the man of God
reading.explain: The text describes how he had the donkey saddled and rode after the man of God.
